It's a great product other than the combination open-end wrench that came with it doesn't fit around the bolts that go into the feet very well. Which isn't terrible because who wants to spend that much time using an open-end wrench on those screws? But other than that I think it's a great product

Solid piece of kit, easy to assemble but you'll need to buy proper shield anchors if fixing it to concrete because the ones supplied were absolute shite, other than that very happy with the product and delivery was quick.
I like the design and heavy-duty plastic construction. I plan to buy more for my jewelry and scrapbooking materials.
It is well-made and durable. Drawers will not slide out accidentally and it is easy to install.

Needed more small hardware storage, this unit works for that. Only issue I had was damage during shipping, busted one of the drawer pulls and discolored the side panel from whatever sat on it. Vevor though offered a partial refund, and I accepted it, and kept the unit.
Works perfectly!! Exactly what I needed for our front door.
